recipes.name: White sandwich bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (1 packet / 7 g) instant or active dry yeast
3 1/2 cups (440 g) bread flour or all-purpose flour
steps: Stir the warm milk, yeast and sugar in a big bowl and let sit for 5 minutes, until foamy.
Add the flour, salt and butter and stir into a shaggy dough.
Knead on a floured counter for 8 to 10 minutes, until smooth and stretchy.
Put it in an oiled bowl, cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Press it flat into a rectangle, roll it up tight from the short end and pinch the seam.
Put it seam side down in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes, until it domes 1 inch over the pan.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and hollow sounding when tapped.
Turn out and let cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: Honey whole wheat bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
1 3/4 cups (220 g) bread flour or all-purpose flour
steps: Stir the water, yeast and honey and let sit for 5 minutes, until foamy.
Stir in the oil, both flours and the salt.
Knead for 10 minutes, until smooth and springy. It will feel a little tacky.
Put it in an oiled bowl, cover and let rise for 1 hour 15 minutes, until doubled.
Shape into a log and put it in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until browned and hollow sounding.
Let cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: French baguettes
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes, until foamy.
Add the flour and salt and knead for 8 to 10 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Split in half. Press each half into a rectangle and roll it into a 14 inch log, tapering the ends.
Put the logs on a floured baking sheet, cover and let rise for 40 minutes.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Put an empty metal pan on the bottom rack.
Have an adult cut 4 slanted slashes on each loaf with a sharp knife.
Put the bread in and have an adult pour 1 cup of hot water into the empty pan to make steam.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until deep golden.
Let cool for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Rosemary focaccia
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour and salt until no dry flour shows. It will be very sticky. No kneading needed.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour 30 minutes, until bubbly and doubled.
Pour 4 tablespoons of the oil into a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Tip the dough into the pan and gently stretch it toward the corners with oiled hands.
Let rise for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Drizzle the rest of the oil on top and press your fingertips all over to make deep dimples.
Sprinkle with rosemary and flaky salt.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then cut into squares.

recipes.name: No-knead crusty bread
ingredients: 3 cups (390 g) all-purpose or bread flour
steps: Stir the flour, yeast, salt and water in a big bowl until a shaggy, sticky dough forms.
Cover and let sit at room temperature for 12 to 18 hours, until bubbly.
Tip onto a floured counter and fold it over itself a few times into a ball.
Set it on parchment, cover and let rest for 1 hour.
Put a covered Dutch oven in the oven and heat to 450°F (230°C) for 30 minutes. An adult should handle the pot.
Lift the dough by the parchment into the hot pot and cover.
Bake for 30 minutes, then take off the lid and bake for 10 to 15 minutes more, until deep brown.
Let cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: Cinnamon rolls
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Filling: 1 cup (220 g) packed brown sugar, 2 1/2 tablespoons ground cinnamon, 1/3 cup (75 g) butter, softened
Icing: 4 oz (115 g) cream cheese, 1/4 cup (55 g) butter, 1 1/2 cups (180 g) powdered sugar, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix in the melted butter, eggs, flour and salt.
Knead for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft and smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Roll the dough into a 16 by 21 inch rectangle.
Spread with the soft butter and sprinkle with the brown sugar and cinnamon.
Roll it up from the long side and cut into 12 rolls with dental floss or a sharp knife.
Put them in a greased 9 by 13 inch pan, cover and let rise for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden.
Beat the icing ingredients and spread on the warm rolls.

recipes.name: Soft pretzels
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
10 cups (2.4 liters) water and 2/3 cup (about 145 g) baking soda for the bath
1 egg yolk beaten with 1 tablespoon water
steps: Stir the warm water, sugar, salt and yeast and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the flour and butter and knead for 5 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult bring the 10 cups water and baking soda to a boil in a big pot.
Split the dough into 8 pieces, roll each into a 24 inch rope and twist into a pretzel shape.
Have an adult dip each pretzel in the boiling water for 30 seconds, then lift it out with a slotted spatula.
Put them on a lined baking sheet, brush with egg wash and sprinkle with coarse salt.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes, until dark golden brown.
For pretzel bites, cut the ropes into 1 inch pieces and bake for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Homemade bagels
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
1 tablespoon honey for the boiling water
Toppings: everything seasoning, sesame seeds or poppy seeds
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the flour and salt and knead for 10 minutes. The dough will be stiff.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Split into 8 balls. Poke your thumb through the middle of each and stretch into a 2 inch hole.
Rest on a lined sheet for 20 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult bring a big pot of water and the honey to a boil.
Boil the bagels 2 or 3 at a time for 1 minute per side, then lift them out with a slotted spoon.
Put them back on the sheet and sprinkle with toppings.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden brown.

recipes.name: Skillet naan
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Garlic butter: 3 tablespoons butter, melted, with 1 minced garlic clove and chopped cilantro
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Stir in the yogurt, oil, flour, salt and baking powder and knead for 5 minutes, until soft.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Split into 8 balls and roll each into an oval about 1/4 inch thick.
Heat a cast iron skillet over medium high heat until very hot. Ask an adult to help.
Cook one naan for 1 to 2 minutes, until bubbles puff up and the bottom has dark spots.
Flip and cook for 1 minute more.
Brush with garlic butter and keep warm under a towel.

recipes.name: Pita bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the flour, salt and oil and knead for 6 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Put a baking sheet in the oven and heat to 475°F (245°C). Ask an adult to help.
Split into 8 balls and roll each into a 6 inch circle about 1/4 inch thick.
Have an adult put 2 or 3 at a time on the hot sheet.
Bake for 4 to 5 minutes, until puffed like balloons and pale golden.
Wrap in a towel right away so they stay soft.

recipes.name: Challah
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
2 large eggs, plus 1 egg for brushing
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Whisk in the oil and 2 eggs, then add the flour and salt.
Knead for 8 to 10 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour 30 minutes, until doubled.
Split into 3 pieces and roll each into a 16 inch rope.
Pinch the ends together at the top and braid them, then pinch the bottom and tuck the ends under.
Put on a lined baking sheet, cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with seeds.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until deep golden.

recipes.name: Homemade burger buns
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
1 large egg, plus 1 egg for brushing
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add 1 egg, the butter, flour and salt and knead for 8 minutes, until soft and smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Split into 8 balls and press each into a 3 1/2 inch disk on a lined sheet. For hot dog buns, shape 6 inch logs.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Monkey bread
ingredients: 2 cans (16.3 oz / 462 g each) refrigerated biscuits
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 12 cup bundt pan.
Mix the sugar and cinnamon in a big zip bag.
Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces with kitchen scissors and shake them in the bag a handful at a time.
Pile the coated pieces into the pan.
Heat the butter and brown sugar in a pot until it boils for 1 minute. Ask an adult to help.
Pour it over the dough.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then flip onto a plate with oven mitts.

recipes.name: Garlic knots
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) pizza dough, store bought or homemade
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut the dough into 12 pieces and roll each into an 8 inch rope.
Tie each rope into a loose knot and put them on a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden.
Melt the butter with the garlic in a small pan over low heat for 2 minutes.
Toss the hot knots in the garlic butter, then sprinkle with parmesan, parsley and salt.

recipes.name: Soft breadsticks
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Topping: 3 tablespoons butter, melted, and 1 teaspoon garlic salt
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the butter, salt and flour and knead for 6 minutes.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Split into 16 pieces and roll each into a 7 inch stick. Put them on lined sheets.
Cover and let rise for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden.
Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with garlic salt.

recipes.name: English muffins
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix in the butter, egg, flour and salt and knead for 5 minutes. It will be soft.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Roll 1/2 inch thick and cut 3 inch circles.
Put them on a cornmeal-dusted tray, sprinkle more cornmeal on top and let rest for 30 minutes.
Heat a griddle or skillet over medium low heat. Ask an adult to help.
Cook for 6 to 8 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through.
Split with a fork and toast.

recipes.name: Hot cross buns
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Cross paste: 1/2 cup (65 g) flour and 1/3 cup (80 ml) water
2 tablespoons apricot jam, warmed, for glazing
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix in the butter, egg, flour, salt and spices and knead for 8 minutes.
Knead in the raisins.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Split into 12 balls and put them in a greased 9 by 13 inch pan. Let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the cross paste and pipe a cross on each bun.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden.
Brush the warm buns with the jam.

recipes.name: Cinnamon swirl raisin bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Swirl: 1/3 cup (65 g) sugar mixed with 1 tablespoon cinnamon, and 1 tablespoon milk for brushing
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the flour, salt and butter and knead for 8 minutes, then knead in the raisins.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Roll into an 8 by 16 inch rectangle, brush with milk and sprinkle with the cinnamon sugar.
Roll it up tight from the short end and put it in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until golden. Cover with foil for the last 10 minutes if it browns fast.
Let cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: Japanese milk bread
ingredients: Tangzhong: 3 tablespoons (25 g) bread flour and 1/2 cup (120 ml) milk
1 large egg, plus 1 egg for brushing
steps: Whisk the tangzhong flour and milk in a small pot over low heat for 1 to 2 minutes, until it turns into a thick paste. Let cool.
Mix the flour, sugar, yeast and salt, then add the warm milk, egg and tangzhong.
Knead for 5 minutes, then knead in the butter.
Knead for 10 to 15 minutes more, until very smooth and stretchy. A stand mixer helps.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Split into 4 balls, roll each into an oval, roll up and stand them side by side in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush with egg and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden.
Let cool for 1 hour. It stays soft for days.

recipes.name: Conchas
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Topping: 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar, 1/2 cup (65 g) flour, 1/4 cup (55 g) butter, 1 teaspoon vanilla, 1 tablespoon cocoa (optional)
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the eggs, butter, flour, salt and vanilla and knead for 8 to 10 minutes. It will be soft.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Mix the topping into a soft paste. Stir cocoa into half if you want brown ones.
Split the dough into 12 balls and set them on lined sheets.
Flatten a ball of topping between plastic wrap and lay it on each bun.
Press a shell pattern into the topping with a knife or concha cutter.
Let rise for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the bottoms are golden.

recipes.name: Brazilian cheese bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (150 g) grated parmesan or a mix of parmesan and mozzarella
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult bring the milk, oil and salt to a boil.
Pour it over the tapioca flour in a bowl and stir until smooth and sticky.
Let cool for 10 minutes.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the cheese.
Scoop 1 1/2 tablespoon balls onto a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until puffed and golden. They are hollow and chewy inside.

recipes.name: Steamed buns
ingredients: 2/3 cup (150 ml) warm milk or water
steps: Mix the flour, yeast and sugar, then stir in the milk and oil.
Knead for 10 minutes, until very smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Roll into a log and cut into 8 pieces. Put each on a square of parchment.
Let rise in the steamer basket for 20 minutes.
Have an adult set the basket over a pot of boiling water and cover.
Steam for 12 to 15 minutes.
Turn off the heat and wait 5 minutes before lifting the lid so they do not shrink.

recipes.name: Flour tortillas
ingredients: 1/4 cup (50 g) shortening, lard or vegetable oil
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder and salt, then rub in the shortening.
Stir in the hot water and knead for 2 minutes, until smooth.
Split into 8 balls, cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Roll each ball into a thin 8 inch circle.
Heat a dry skillet over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Cook each tortilla for 30 to 60 seconds per side, until bubbly with light brown spots.
Stack them in a towel to keep soft.

recipes.name: Corn tortillas
steps: Mix the masa harina, salt and water into a soft dough like play dough. Add water a spoonful at a time if it cracks.
Cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Roll into 12 balls.
Press each ball between 2 pieces of plastic in a tortilla press or under a heavy pan to about 6 inches.
Heat a dry skillet over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Cook for 1 minute, flip and cook for 1 minute, then flip again for 30 seconds. It may puff.
Keep warm in a towel.

recipes.name: Chocolate babka
ingredients: Filling: 4 oz (115 g) chocolate and 1/2 cup (115 g) butter melted together, 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar, 1/4 cup (20 g) cocoa
Syrup: 1/3 cup (65 g) sugar and 1/3 cup (80 ml) water
steps: Mix the milk, yeast, sugar, eggs, flour and salt, then knead in the butter for 10 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Stir the filling together until smooth.
Roll the dough into a 10 by 15 inch rectangle and spread the filling over it.
Roll up from the long side and chill for 15 minutes.
Cut the log in half lengthwise and twist the two halves together, cut sides up.
Put in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan and let rise for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 35 to 45 minutes, until a skewer comes out without wet dough.
Boil the syrup ingredients for 1 minute and brush over the hot babka.

recipes.name: Chapati
ingredients: 2 cups (240 g) whole wheat atta flour
steps: Mix the flour and salt, then add the oil and water and knead for 5 minutes into a soft dough.
Cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Split into 8 balls and roll each into a thin 7 inch circle, dusting with flour.
Heat a dry skillet over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Cook for 30 to 60 seconds, until bubbles show, then flip.
Cook for 1 minute, pressing gently with a folded towel so it puffs.
Brush with ghee and stack in a towel.

recipes.name: Honey oat bread
ingredients: 1 cup (90 g) rolled oats, plus more for the top
2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
steps: Pour the boiling water over the oats, honey and butter. Let sit for 20 minutes, until just warm. Ask an adult to help.
Stir the yeast into the warm water and add it to the oats.
Add the flour and salt and knead for 8 minutes.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Shape into a log, brush the top with water, sprinkle with oats and put it in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until golden.
Let cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: Swedish cardamom buns
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Filling: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, softened, 1/2 cup (110 g) packed brown sugar, 2 teaspoons cardamom, 1 teaspoon cinnamon
1 egg for brushing and pearl sugar or coarse sugar
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the butter, cardamom, salt and flour and knead for 8 minutes.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Roll into a 12 by 16 inch rectangle, spread with the filling and fold into thirds like a letter.
Cut into 12 strips. Twist each strip and tie it into a knot.
Put on lined sheets and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush with egg and sprinkle with pearl sugar.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden.
